start_welcome:
Private AI bot. Runs locally, no cloud.
Capabilities: text questions to a local model.
Commands:
/reset — clear this chat's history
/status — model and server status
/voice — toggle voice replies
🤖 Agent: /agent <task> — plan, your confirmation, sandbox execution.
voice_not_recognized: Couldn't recognize the voice message, please type it
agent_quota_exceeded: Daily limit of agent tasks ({limit}) reached — the limit protects free access for everyone. Come back tomorrow.
agent_no_plan: Agent couldn't make a plan. Try rephrasing.
agent_plan_inactive: Plan is no longer active. Start again: /agent <task>
agent_overload_notice: Cloud brain is overloaded, switching to backup — a couple of minutes
voice_off: Voice replies disabled (voice messages are still transcribed).
plan_empty: Empty plan - the agent couldn't split the task
task_timeout: Aborted by the overall timeout of {s}s
